🇨🇳🇵🇭 || China's coast guard has accused a Philippine vessel of deliberately ramming one of its ships near the contested Scarborough Shoal, while the Philippines counters that Chinese forces unleashed powerful water cannons for nearly 30 minutes, causing significant damage to the BRP Datu Gumbay Piang—including shattered glass injuring a crew member and electrical short circuits—amid efforts to supply fuel and aid to over 35 Filipino fishing boats

💥 The incident unfolded just six days after China designated part of the shoal as a national nature reserve, prompting a diplomatic protest from Manila, which calls it Bajo de Masinloc.

⚠️ With both nations trading blame in the strategically vital waters rich in fishing grounds, allies like the US, UK, Australia, and Canada have voiced support for the Philippines, condemning China's actions as coercive attempts to assert sweeping claims.

🔥 This latest flare-up highlights ongoing rivalries in the South China Sea, where multiple countries stake competing territorial interests.
